name: Write docs a new developer can follow on day one
why: Reads a codebase and produces a README, quickstart and first-run test, the same path as the readme-and-setup-guide skill.

name: Monthly developer docs keeper
why: Finds stale pages and broken steps after changes each month, the upkeep half of the docs-as-code release cycle.

name: Monthly help centre keeper
why: Runs the monthly ticket-to-article loop: questions the help pages miss, new drafts and stale pages fixed.

name: Help article writer from support tickets
why: Turns a group of tickets about one problem into a short article titled in the customer's words.

name: FAQ page writer from customer questions
why: Builds an FAQ page from real customer questions and approved answers, grouped by topic.

name: Plain English editor
why: Rewrites a draft in plain words with each cut explained, a quick pass before any page ships.

name: Check a release and its docs
why: Finds test gaps and stale docs before a release, matching steps 2 to 7 of the release cycle workflow.

name: Turn a spec into a tested service with API docs
why: Goes from a written spec to a service, API tests and an API spec; the API reference skill then documents it.

name: Make onboarding instructions match the product
why: Corrects first-use instructions and labels against the real product, the test-as-a-new-user check in this kit.

name: Set up a documentation system and write procedures that pass
why: Sets up a documentation system with procedures and runbooks for internal teams, with a check of each.

name: Product how-to guide writer
why: Writes numbered how-to routines from product facts and buyer problems, useful for product pages next to the manual.

name: Release manager
why: Gives a go or no-go, version and changelog before each release; pair it with the release notes prompt.
